snippet.title: Level 500 Knight vs The Void Sovereign | Zarethia Gameplay
snippet.description:
A level 500 knight cuts through the Throne of the Void and its floors, then faces the Void Sovereign, one of the toughest bosses in Zarethia.

Throne of the Void: Void Knights and Void Wyrms
Floor −1, Void Hollow: Void Wyrms and Void Slimes
Floor +1, Shattered Stairs: Void Wyrms and Void Gargoyles
Boss: The Void Sovereign, level 503

Zarethia is a free pixel-art MMORPG for Android and PC: https://zarethia.com

#Zarethia #MMORPG #PixelArt #IndieGame
